name: lumen-forge
description: LUMEN FORGE production roadmap (vertical slice). Governance pack = /home/jayson/Desktop/3 (HARNESS UPGRADES v2.1 + GAME DIRECTIONS Lumen Forge v2.1), FINAL LAW for the harness. Read every .md under it before production work. User overrides (binding): opencode = Main Orchestrator (xAI disallowed, Groq primary, NVIDIA fallback + vision deck); Unity + Godot equal; 4 build targets honest (no faking). Production rule: the HARNESS does all research/asset-production via its workers; the orchestrator never does worker work. Platform: Meta Quest 3 primary (Unity), Windows (Unity), Linux + Android (Godot). Vertical slice loop: stylized splash/menu -> in-station start -> ~25-30 unique non-primitive modules -> diagnostic probe -> 5-tier anomaly escalation -> 4-6 seeded crew with routines/dialogue -> dead star observation + pulse -> shift cycle Rest -> quarters -> ending cinematic. No black screens, no broken cameras, no soft-locks on the critical path. Manifest = /root/Desktop/Beef/harness/projects.json (pid lumen-forge). Pack unpacked at workspace/lumen-forge/ (00_Master..08_Implementation_Notes). Harness code home: /root/Desktop/Beef/harness (src/runner.py, src/v21.py, src/app.py).
